mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sync_task_log(id, task_id, task_name, trigger_type, schedule_id, state, start_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{triggerType}, #{scheduleId}, #{state}, #{startTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sync_task_log SET log_file = #{logFile} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sync_task_log SET state = 'RUNNING' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sync_task_log SET state = 'FAILED', message = #{message} WHERE state IN ('RUNNING', 'QUEUED')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sync_task_log WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM sync_task_log WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
